description: The registered SmolLM3 configuration cannot consume the inspected SmolLM3-3B-Base config unchanged.
trigger: Select HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B-Base at the inspected revision through Config.from_directory, with its valid checkpoint files available.
expected_behavior: Construct the architecture configuration using its interval-based RoPE description, or otherwise support this reference variant.
actual_behavior: SmolLM3Config requires no_rope_layers with no_default. Base supplies no_rope_layer_interval=4 but no list, so read_dict raises ValueError before model construction. The factory passes the directory unchanged and provides no interval-to-list adaptation. The reach is configuration selection for this variant, not every existing factory caller or every SmolLM3 checkpoint.

verification.description: Compared all three reference configs with the task constructor and inspected the generic factory and typed-key reader. Whole-parent searches found no pre-existing SmolLM3 config builder or no_rope adaptation.
verification.limits: Full configuration initialization and checkpoint loading were not executed.

verification.description: Executed the parent repository's extracted read_dict body in isolation with the missing-list condition and no_default sentinel; it raised ValueError naming no_rope_layers.
verification.limits: Annotations were removed for isolated standard-library execution; this tests the helper, not the patched model.

introductions.rationale: New architecture constructor requires a mask absent from the pinned Base config; approved as a new identity by302 verdict.
